snippet.title: GitNation React Conferences
snippet.description:
Welcome to the channel for the family of React conferences from GitNation:

React Summit Amsterdam - https://reactsummit.com
React Advanced London - http://reactadvanced.com
React Day Berlin - https://reactday.berlin

We organize events for a bigger cause — we want the modern tech community to become a better place for developers and enthusiasts alike by encouraging professional growth opportunities, skills evolution, and nurturing passion for the craft.
